searchText: <@403707149043105803> would you need prague and praugeEOF be activated at the same time? I thought we discussed yesterday on the call that we not going to pursue `cancunEOFTime`. PragueEOF can be different. If we are going Cancun->PragueEOF you can just set those two, but besu supports PragueEOF as a distinct fork. I thought long term yes, btut short term it was a nice to have? Either way, CancunEOFTime is cancun+EOF, and would succeed to PragueEOFTime. With that PR both EOF variants are supported so we can do whatever we need. would nethermind be able to do this kind of trick too? I’m happy to add the cancunEOFTime to our ethereum genesis generator too, as long as we have at least one other EL that will support it. current version of ethereum package now support pragueEOFTime I would just go with `PragueEOF` and not complicate things One liner to get up and running with eof `kurtosis run github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package --args-file https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package/main/.github/tests/eof.yaml` <@403707149043105803> <@907931206081990666> <@275684146658148352> <@425274498732916736> PR https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/631 is now merged, so no need to use `max_stack_height` anymore (most of the time). There's also now a `Container.Code` shortcut to create a container with a single code section, which is what we use most of the time I think. New EIP-7692 execution-spec-tests release: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/releases/tag/eip7692%40v1.0.4

excerpts.content: I thought we discussed yesterday on the call that we not going to pursue `cancunEOFTime`.

excerpts.author: _shemnon
excerpts.content: PragueEOF can be different.  If we are going Cancun->PragueEOF you can just set those two, but besu supports PragueEOF as a distinct fork.

excerpts.author: _shemnon
excerpts.content: I thought long term yes, btut short term it was a nice to have?  Either way, CancunEOFTime is cancun+EOF, and would succeed to PragueEOFTime.  With that PR both EOF variants are supported so we can do whatever we need.

excerpts.content: I’m happy to add the cancunEOFTime to our ethereum genesis generator too, as long as we have at least one other EL that will support it.

excerpts.author: barnabasbusa
excerpts.content:
One liner to get up and running with eof 

`kurtosis run github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package --args-file https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package/main/.github/tests/eof.yaml`

excerpts.author: marioevz
excerpts.content:
<@403707149043105803> <@907931206081990666> <@275684146658148352> <@425274498732916736> PR https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/631 is now merged, so no need to use `max_stack_height`  anymore (most of the time).

There's also now a `Container.Code` shortcut to create a container with a single code section, which is what we use most of the time I think.
